features: Perimeter detection large model: 64 channels (tripwire crossing, intrusion, loitering, area exit, fast movement, area entry, parking detection)
Video storage: a minimum of 32 channels, 320 Mbit/s (64 Mbit/s deducted for image-based analysis in device-edge synergy); forwarding: 64 channels, 320 Mbit/s
Computing power: 20 TOPS; 64-bit 4-core CPU; 12 GB memory
SafeVideo, recording lock, and resumable upload
AES256 media encryption; digital watermarking with tamper alarms
Device access: HOLOWITS SDK, GB/T 28181 and ONVIF
Supported disks: enterprise 4/6/8/10/16 TB; monitoring 6 TB
USB 2.0 and USB 3.0 ports (2 x USB 2.0, 1 x USB 3.0)
notes: Product page states RAID 1 is supported only by the system disks.
Operating temperature -10 to 55 C applies without disks or with disks rated -5 to 70 C; 0 to 45 C with disks rated 5 to 60 C.
